services.name: Hot Yin Yoga
services.desc: Yin Yoga at AetherHaus is a slow, sauna-based class that combines the grounding rhythm of yin yoga postures with the gentle heat of a hot yin yoga environment. Each session focuses on deep stretches, supported poses, and stillness that bring the body and mind back to a state of rest. The practice unfolds between heat and cool; allowing muscles to soften, flexibility to return, and recovery to deepen. The session begins with a short meditation in our Himalayan salt sauna to begin the process of unwinding. Guests will then get time to free flow through the space on their own time.
